title: Preserve 13 orphaned source identifiers as explicit unresolved stubs; exclude them from evidence admission
context: The PR #1450 validator now passes archive pointer/schema and archive_policy checks but fails because 13 source IDs referenced by the latest snapshot are absent from the source archive.
The 13 IDs were present in the 06:40 snapshot and its source bundle existing_source_references list; the inspected source bundles did not contain their full records.
decisions: Add 13 source registry stubs with exact referenced IDs and null metadata; label each UNRESOLVED_SOURCE_REFERENCE_STUB.
Do not invent titles, URLs, publishers, dates or claims; the stub records are not admissible evidence or prediction features.
Recover original metadata from official filings, company pages or source revisions in a later append-only correction; preserve stubs and history.
Keep PR #1450 draft/unmerged until exact-head archive validation and fail-closed gate pass.
unresolved: Original metadata for all 13 source IDs.
Whether any IDs are duplicate aliases of other canonical source records; no alias mapping is asserted without evidence.

feature_admission.reason: Source metadata is unrecovered; identifier-only stubs cannot support claims or features.
